name: Mondrian Cannes
positioning: Modern design hotel on Boulevard de la Croisette in Cannes, beside the Mediterranean, with exclusive access to the Hyde Beach Cannes private beach
best_for: Travelers who want a Croisette base a short walk from the Palais des Festivals
Couples who want a top-floor room or suite with a sea-facing terrace

facts.text: Mondrian Cannes is steps from the Mediterranean shore and minutes from the Palais des Festivals et des Congrès.
The hotel is about a five-minute walk from the Palais des Festivals.
Rooms and suites are spread across eleven floors above Boulevard de la Croisette, beside the Mediterranean Sea.
Rooms feature curved lines of soft, aqua-hued flooring and modern design shaped by the seaside setting.
Deluxe City View rooms are on the top floor, looking over the town of Cannes and the surrounding hills.
The Serenity Suite is on the top floor, with a terrace facing the countryside hills and overlooking the city.
Hyde Beach Cannes sits on the sandy beach along La Croisette and serves an Italian menu, casual by day and lively in the evening.
Mr. Nakamoto, the hotel's restaurant and bar, pairs local and seasonal ingredients with Asian flavors.
Every Saturday morning, Hyde Beach Cannes hosts the Hyde Boxing Club workout by the sea.
The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
Children under 12 stay and have breakfast free when sharing their parents' room.
Ferries to the Lérins Islands leave from a nearby pier.

highlights.text: The Signature Suites sit on the top floor, the highest point on the Croisette, with views of the bay of Cannes from a private furnished terrace.
The Panoramic Terrace room, on the top floor overlooking the Croisette and the sea, has a private spa on its sea-facing terrace.
Guests have exclusive access to Hyde Beach Cannes, the hotel's private beach restaurant directly on La Croisette.
Prestige Sea View Terrace rooms come with a furnished private sea-facing terrace and a marble shower or bathtub.
The concierge can arrange private tours of the Côte d'Azur, excursions to the Lérins Islands and private boat rentals.

considerations.text: There is no on-site spa or wellness center; the concierge can arrange appointments at nearby spas in Cannes.
Parking is available at a daily charge and should be arranged with the hotel in advance.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury Cannes location.
